description.value: A large old-growth forest campground 1 km from the famous historic boardwalk village, serving as the base for world-class orca watching in Johnstone Strait and coastal kayaking; open May–September only, with tent sites starting at $45/night.

address.value: 1800 Bauza Creek Road, Telegraph Cove Rd, Telegraph Cove, BC V0N 3P0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground (branded 'The Forest RV Campground') at Telegraph Cove Resort on northern Vancouver Island, open seasonally May–September. The campground page explicitly lists showers, laundromat, washrooms, firewood, and sani-dump, and welcomes both tenters and RVs. The dining and general store pages confirm food is available nearby in the village. The resort's news page confirms the 2026 season opened May 1. OSM name 'Telegraph Cove Campground' differs from website branding 'The Forest RV Campground', and the OSM phone (+1 250 928 3131) differs from the toll-free number (1-800-200-4665) shown on the website.
